# ToolsBoXMachine (TBXM)

> A collection of free, privacy-first browser tools for everyday tasks. No tracking, no accounts required.

TBXM is an open-source toolbox running entirely client-side. All processing happens in the browser. No data ever leaves your device.

## Tools

- [Blur Image](/tools/blur/blur): Protect privacy by blurring sensitive parts of images
- [Calculator](/tools/calculator/calculator): Perform basic arithmetic calculations
- [Password Generator](/tools/password-gen/password-gen): Generate secure passwords or passphrases
- [QR Code Generator](/tools/qr-gen/qr-gen): Create custom QR codes for any link or text
- [Pomodoro Timer](/tools/timer/timer): Stay focused with timed work sessions
- [Emoji Keyboard](/tools/emoji-keyboard/emoji-keyboard): Browse and copy emojis with one click
- [Notes](/tools/note/note): Create, save, and manage notes
- [Clock](/tools/clock/clock): Display the current time
- [New Year Countdown](/tools/new-year-countdown/new-year-countdown): Live countdown with the days, hours, minutes and seconds until January 1st, in your timezone

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Tools Index (JSON)](/tools/index.json): Full tool catalog with metadata
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlers
- [Robots.txt](/robots.txt): Crawl rules and bot permissions
- [MCP Server Card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP tool definitions
- [Agent Skills](/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Task-specific skill index
- [Full Documentation](/seo/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation dump

## Content Signals

- ai-train: allowed (open source, Unlicense)
- ai-input: allowed (all tools run client-side)
- search: index
